notes:
CRM snapshot: short, technical, action-oriented.
- Account: mid-market product analytics company building in-product ML features (search, assistant, rerank).
- Initial path: evaluated Hosted API for quick integration; now running Dedicated POC for predictable throughput and data isolation.
- POC scope: 3-week Dedicated trial (reserved GPU pool, autoscale off for controlled canary). Canary phases: 10% -> 30% -> 60% (each 48-72h), rollback allowed between phases.
- Canary routing plan: start in us-east-1 (primary), failover to us-west-2 if per-region latency/availability breach. Secondary plan: eu-west-1 for EU traffic only to satisfy residency.
- Model variants: prefer redwood-13b-quant for quality-critical flows, redwood-7b-int8 for low-cost high-throughput reranking. Fallback rules: if p95 latency > 400ms or error rate > 2% for 10m -> route to smaller variant with identical semantic profile.
- Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate delta > +1.5% over baseline, quality regression on eval prompts (BLEU/ROUGE drop), or cost-per-request > threshold set in pricing deck.
- Observability: AE set up tracing & per-token cost tags; SE integrated KV cache metrics, batching level, and model-variant labeling. Alerting: paged on p95 > 500ms or token-cost spike > 25% over rolling 24h.
- Security: require SSO/SAML + customer-managed KMS. Need SOC2 attestation and audit log export to their SIEM.
- Quote from CTO: "We need a canary + guaranteed fallback path — can't have regressions in the assistant during peak usage."
- Cost sensitivity: willing to trade quality for cost on background jobs (rerank/batch embeddings), but strict on chat latency and top-N quality for product assistants.
- Internal stakeholders: VP Product (product decision), Head of Infra (ops sign-off), Security Director (SAML/KMS).
- Commercial: expecting an ARR band between $75k-$200k depending on committed capacity and contract term. Negotiating 12-month reserved commit.
- Open items: final KMS integration checklist, clarify multi-region egress billing, finalize SLA for Dedicated p95 latency targets.
- Short-term ask: Redwood SE to produce detailed canary runbook + rollback playbook and sample Prometheus dashboards for the POC.
use_case_summary: Mid-market SaaS product team running POC to migrate production assistant + reranking from Hosted API to Dedicated. Objective: predictable p95 latency < 300ms for chat, throughput 200 req/s for rerank, cost control via quantized model variants and autoscaling policies.
poc_plan: Week 0: sandbox + infra prep. Week 1: 10% canary (us-east), validate latency/cost/quality. Week 2: ramp to 30% + region failover test. Week 3: 60% canary with rollback dry-run, finalize pricing & commit. Success metrics: latency SLOs met, error rate <= 1%, quality parity within 2% of baseline eval set.
decision_criteria: 1) Security sign-off (SAML & KMS), 2) Meet latency/quality SLOs under canary, 3) Predictable unit economics (cost-model within forecast), 4) Ops runbook + rollback verified.
